title: Buffering circuit inputs
statement: Let $n,m$ be nonnegative integers, let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $m$ input vertices, and let $s$ assign to each of those inputs either one of $n$ new input vertices or a Boolean constant. The circuit on $n$ inputs formed by first adding input gates for the assignment specified by $s$, then appending the gates of $C$ with all their referenced vertices shifted by $n$, has output vertex $n$ plus the output vertex of $C$.
hypotheses_covered: circuit $C$ on $m$ inputs, with gates in topological order and valid earlier-vertex references
